tool.name: CreateNetworkDataset
tool.summary: Create a walk-optimised network dataset from Overture Maps segment (edge) and connector (junction) features. The tool orchestrates the full preparation pipeline: subclass splitting, level splitting, connector splitting, boolean access restriction field creation, walk impedance calculation, and network dataset creation from an XML template. Optionally downloads segment and connector features directly from Overture Maps for a given extent.

usage.bullet_item: Set Download Data to True to have the tool fetch segment and connector features from Overture Maps for the supplied extent. Set it to False to use pre-downloaded feature layers.
When downloading, provide a polygon extent layer. Features outside the extent polygon are clipped automatically.

When not downloading, supply existing polyline segment features and point connector features that already have the Overture schema fields (connectors, subclass_rules, level_rules, access_restrictions, class, subtype).
The output geodatabase must be a file geodatabase. The tool creates a feature dataset and network dataset inside it.
If the feature dataset or features already exist in the geodatabase, existing data is reused.
The completed network dataset is automatically added to the active map when running inside ArcGIS Pro.

param.name: download_data
param.dialogReference: When True, the tool downloads segment and connector features from Overture Maps for the given extent. When False, existing feature layers must be provided.

param.name: extent
param.dialogReference: A polygon feature set defining the spatial extent for downloading Overture features. Required when Download Data is True. The extent is projected to WGS 84 automatically if needed.

param.name: segment_features
param.dialogReference: An existing polyline feature layer containing Overture segment features. Required when Download Data is False.

param.name: connector_features
param.dialogReference: An existing point feature layer containing Overture connector features. Required when Download Data is False.

param.name: geodatabase
param.dialogReference: The file geodatabase where the feature dataset and network dataset will be created.

param.name: feature_dataset_name
param.dialogReference: Name of the feature dataset to create or use inside the geodatabase. Default: overture_transportation.

param.name: network_dataset_name
param.dialogReference: Name of the network dataset to create inside the feature dataset. Default: overture_network.
